description:
Apply a Photoshop Neural Filter via the companion UXP bridge plugin.

Use when: skin smoothing, harmonize composite layers, depth blur, super zoom, or colorizing B&W photos.
Do NOT use when: uxp_bridge_reachable is false — install uxp-plugin per docs/development.md.

Returns: { ok, summary, details }.
Preconditions: UXP bridge plugin running in Photoshop; PS 22+.

document_id.description: Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. Send null to use the active document. A number activates that document before the tool runs.

reference_layer_id.description: Layer id for harmonize reference (harmonize only)

name: photoshop_neural_filter
